name: Chalcedony
source:
"The Timid Papa Demon King"

The current Demon King. 
Unlike Forbessi, Chalcedony is more of a muscle-bound powerhouse type. His formidable body and stern face might look intimidating, but he's actually quite humble and a bit on the timid side. Chalcedony's a devoted dad, always giving it his all to look after his sickly wife. And, just like Forbessi, he's a complete softie when it comes to his wife and daughter.

"Whew, you had me worried there~. For a second, Papa didn't know what was going to happen..."

Likes: Daughters, wife, friends, housework
Dislikes: Corruption, conspiracies

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/subcharacter.html]official website[/url]]
